acceptanceCriteria: pool release uses the writer route (or an equivalent bounded path) with unchanged safety guarantees.
Measured release time at 47k is retained.
body: Residual from V1-1626 (PR #1089). Expected: pool release is sub-second like heartbeat/renew on the writer route. Actual: 35-60 s complete/prefix audit per release on a 47k store (harness rows in both lane runs, gh-acquire-scratch reports).
title: pool release is not on the writer route: each release pays a 35-60 s complete/prefix audit
